notes: All game sound now stops when the game loses focus: switching tabs, minimising, locking a phone, or switching apps. It comes back at your saved volumes.
Music is now the main layer in the mix, and the default environment volume is lower. If you have changed your volume settings before, they are kept.
Settings now explain each volume control. Mute music and Mute all stay separate.
A redesigned download page with routes, vehicles, controls and feedback links.
A way to tell us you'd like to help with the project, and a Support screen. Support options are not active yet, and nothing in the game depends on them.
The Android update installs over beta.1, because it uses the same signing key and a higher version code.
